chunks: The crucified person is taken down from the wooden structure after three days, washed, and buried. It is not permissible for his crucifixion to remain for more than three days.

key_terms.اَلْخَشَبَةِ: the wooden structure on which the person is suspended
key_terms.اَلْمَصْلُوبُ: the person who has been crucified
key_terms.صَلْبُهُ: his remaining in a crucified state
key_terms.يُغَسَّلُ: is to be ritually washed after death
key_terms.يُنْزَلُ: is to be brought down or taken down

ai.seo_question: How long may a crucified person remain on the cross according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the treatment of a crucified person after execution. It states that the body must be taken down after three days, then given ghusl and burial, and that leaving the person crucified beyond three days is not permissible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5122 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The crucified person is to be taken down from the wooden structure after three days, washed, and buried. It is not permissible to keep him crucified for more than three days."
